acceptanceCriteria: Either corvint affected accepts an explicit changed-path list at HEAD with the existing fallback vocabulary, or impact receipts state the reverse-import closure depth and that the list is not a closed selection.
A READY receipt never implies a complete test selection it does not have.
Spec requirements and tests cover a two-hop importer case.
body: From GitHub issue beamfall/corvint#1301 (opened 2026-10-20). Feature request; not yet specified. **Observed.** `corvint impact PATH...` returns one-hop syntax evidence (the changed path and its direct reverse importers, including test files). Tests reached through a second hop (a test importing a module that imports the changed path) are absent, while the receipt still reports `state: READY`, no unknowns and no uncertainty. `corvint affected` produces a selection plan but only from the dirty worktree, a `--base` commit range, or a `--snapshot` receipt; there is no mode taking an arbitrary list of changed paths at the captured revision. **Wanted.** Either `corvint affected --paths PATH...` (plan for these paths at HEAD, with the same fallback vocabulary such as `FULL_RELEVANT_SUITE`), or an explicit field on impact receipts stating the closure depth and that the result is not a closed test selection (for example `selection_closed: false`, `reverse_import_depth: 1`). **Why.** A consum See beamfall/corvint#1301 for the full text.
title: No path-list mode for a closed affected-test selection (issue #1301)
